name: Le Meridien Nice
positioning: Le Meridien Nice: a mid-century modern hotel at No. 1 Promenade des Anglais, between the Old Town and the shopping district, with a heated rooftop pool and sea views
best_for: Travelers who want a central Nice base on the Promenade des Anglais, close to the Old Town
Design and art lovers drawn to mid-century interiors and works by local artists
Families who want family rooms, suites or interconnecting rooms

facts.text: The hotel is at No. 1 Promenade des Anglais in Nice, with garden and sea views.
The hotel sits between Nice Old Town, the Promenade des Anglais and the shopping district.
Rooms and suites have modern interiors with a mid-century aesthetic.
Room decor uses sandy tones, asymmetric furniture, leather braiding, wicker, raffia and driftwood.
Each marble en-suite bathroom has an illuminated mirror and premium products.
The Panoramic Suite has a spacious corner terrace with teak loungers overlooking the sea.
The Presidential Suite features three artworks by local artist Guillaume Cavalier.
The lobby hosts an exhibition by local artist SAB featuring her blue chair, a symbol of the Promenade des Anglais.
Le Meridien Hub overlooks the Mediterranean Sea and combines reception, co-working space and bar in an open-plan setting.
Families can choose spacious suites, family rooms and interconnecting rooms.
Elaio serves Mediterranean cuisine inspired by the olive, with panoramic sea views.
Latitude Bar was designed by Saguez & Partners in collaboration with designer and interior architect Didier Gomez.

highlights.text: The heated rooftop swimming pool is open year-round, with the Mediterranean Sea as its backdrop.
The Mediterranean Suite was redesigned by Galeries Lafayette with AM.PM furniture and accessories, and a personal shopper can come directly to the suite.
The Presidential Suite has the largest private terrace in the hotel, overlooking the Promenade des Anglais and the Mediterranean Sea.
The 10th-floor rooftop has a fresco by local artist Django.
Elaio is the highest restaurant on the Promenade des Anglais, with a panorama over the Baie des Anges.

considerations.text: Not every room faces the sea: some room categories have city or courtyard views.
Parking is available at an Interparking car park right underneath the hotel, in the same building.
WhataHotel notes an urban hotel setting without private beach access.
